title: Full requirement register — every line of the 2026-11-15 brief, verbatim
policy: Requirement text is transcribed verbatim from the owner's brief. Status values: implemented | partial | open | resolved-at-source | rejected | process. Evidence names the workspace artifact that exists in the repo (verified by this session's file reads); peer work is cited, not re-claimed. The official_source link points to the official page the requirement consumes or governs — it supports the requirement's data domain, not its implementation status. 'Gate that blocks it' and 'number that would clear it' make the path to a decision explicit. Unknown numbers are blank and flagged, never inferred.

gates_referenced.G1-G8: nfl-book pre-registered validation gates (data/gates.json, committed before evaluation)
gates_referenced.D1: nfl-book demotion gate (four firing conditions, live→paper)
gates_referenced.MG-1..MG-8 / DM-1..DM-5: nfl-markets gates and demotion state machine
gates_referenced.DR-G1: official price source gate (this register): an official or operator-archived pre-kickoff line series exists and is licensed for use
gates_referenced.DR-G2: snapshot cadence gate (this register): >=3 retained, hashed captures per game week with zero unresolved schema drift
gates_referenced.DR-G3: designation calibration gate (this register): >=1,000 designation-to-inactive observations over >=3 seasons, play-rate 95% CI half-width <= 5 pp
gates_referenced.DR-G4: joint-evidence gate (this register): a directly validated joint probability plus operator void/push rules are on file before any combo is ranked
gates_referenced.DR-G5: holdout gate (this register): train/validation/holdout seasons frozen in git before evaluation; holdout touched exactly once

rows.clearing_number: opens+close captured for every originated market per week (2026 target n=284 games x 3 markets)
